complications.name: Night action
complications.effect: no visual identification until close; radar matters or you are blind

complications.name: Fog
complications.effect: visual gone, sonar degraded, everything at knife range

complications.name: Heavy sea
complications.effect: gunnery and torpedo accuracy down for both sides; boat work impossible

complications.name: Short of the right ammunition
complications.effect: the obvious answer is the one you cannot afford

complications.name: Friendly shipping in the line of fire
complications.effect: firing arcs constrained, misses have consequences

complications.name: Reinforcements on a timer
complications.effect: a displayed clock; win before it or leave

complications.name: Enemy already damaged and running
complications.effect: pursuit costs fuel and pulls you off route

complications.name: Rescue obligation in the middle of it
complications.effect: survivors in the water where you want to manoeuvre

complications.name: A sensor is out
complications.effect: radar or sonar destroyed or unpowered going in

complications.name: A second threat type joins
complications.effect: surface fight becomes surface plus air, on one budget

complications.name: The objective is a window, not a kill
complications.effect: hold a position or a bearing for a stated time

complications.name: Fuel state forces a short fight
complications.effect: you cannot afford a long engagement or a chase

complications.name: The enemy holds the better position
complications.effect: up-sun, up-weather, or between you and the exit

complications.name: Neutral shipping present
complications.effect: identification required before firing; a mistake costs standing

complications.name: A damaged friendly needs screening
complications.effect: you are protecting something that cannot move fast
